description: This file defines a utility class `DeviceCredentialUtil` for handling device credential checks on Android. It provides a static method to determine if device credentials are available by utilizing the `KeyguardManager` system service.

classes.name: DeviceCredentialUtil
classes.description: Utility class with methods for handling device credentials, including checking if credentials are available on the device.

methods.name: areCredentialsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if device credentials (such as PIN, pattern, or password) are set and available on the device.
